thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on edge gateway (nyc-edge-1) for /v1/generate. 5m error rate 7.4% (threshold 2%). Paging @oncall. See dashboard: https://ops.redwood.internal/d/edge-errors
Maya (oncall): ack — I’m on it. Starting trace collection and checking recent deploys.
Ben (infra): seeing lots of 502/504 from gateway -> runtime-proxy. Connection resets and upstream timeouts spike at 12:03 UTC. p95 latency jumped to 420ms.
Rina (sre): any config rollouts to gateway or proxy in last 30m?
Ben (infra): no gateway config, but there was an autoscaler event scaling up runtime pool-3 at ~11:59. Could be cold nodes or a failing instance.
Tom (eng-runtime): I’m pulling logs from runtime pool-3. Noticing repeated OOM kills on instance i-0a1b2c3d around 12:01. Restart loop.
Maya (oncall): OK that matches the timeline. For immediate mitigation: can we fail traffic from nyc-edge-1 to runtime pool-3 and let it steer to pool-2?
Ben (infra): I can route out of pool-3 at the LB level. Will flip a weight to 0 for pool-3 in the next 30s and monitor.
Ben (infra): doing it now — command: ```
# set pool-3 weight to 0 on edge lb
curl -X POST "https://lb-api.internal/v1/weights" -H "Authorization: Bearer $LBAPI" -d '{"pool":"runtime-pool-3","weight":0}'
```
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T11:58:44 by tom-deploy succeeded for runtime-service@v2.7.1 (no forced restart).
Maya (oncall): after weight flip, error rate dropped from 7.4% -> 1.1% in the 1m panel. Still seeing some 502s from nyc-edge-1 but trending down.
Rina (sre): good. Next: we need a hotfix to stop the OOM/restart cycle in pool-3 images (possible memory regression in v2.7.1). Tom, can engineering build a patched runtime and coord a canary?
Tom (eng-runtime): yes. I’ll cut v2.7.2 with a memory cap tweak and a safer cache init. Starting CI now. Canary to pool-3 only after patch.
Kathy (qa): quick smoke tests on canary once available. I can run the minimal prompt suite.
Maya (oncall): assigning immediate incident roles: incident lead = Maya, mitigation lead = Ben, engineering lead = Tom, QA = Kathy, postmortem owner = Rina.
Rina (sre): alert tuning note — the edge 5xx alert fired at ~7% sustained which was good, but noisy from cascade retries. Action: add upstream timeouts > 10% and sustained 5m window to reduce duplicate pages.
Ben (infra): marking throttles: gateway retry policy should be decreased for runtime-proxy (currently 3 retries) to 1 while we stabilize. I can push that change in the gateway config: ```
gateway.retry_policy = {max_retries:1, backoff_ms:50}
```
Tom (eng-runtime): CI passed, building v2.7.2. I’ll push to staging and then canary to one instance in pool-3. ETA 12m.
Maya (oncall): good. Also logging: capture a sample of failing request ids for customer impact assessment. We need to know which API keys saw 5xx. Can devs pull request ids from traces?
Ben (infra): yes—uploading failing request ids to incident bucket: s3://incidents/1799004321/failing-requests.json (partial).
Tom (eng-runtime): applied canary to 1/10 instances in pool-3. Monitoring CPU/mem and error rate.
Kathy (qa): canary smoke passed (prompt suite green), latency normal. No OOM in the canary for 5m.
Maya (oncall): error rate on nyc-edge-1 back down to 0.9% across 5m, customer-facing errors minimal. Scaling and routing mitigations held.
Rina (sre): proposed immediate post-incident action items (short):
- Hotfix: roll v2.7.2 to pool-3 and then full fleet if stable (owner: Tom)
- Runbook: update "edge -> runtime 5xx" section to include LB weight flip and runtime OOM symptoms (owner: Rina)
- Alert tuning: adjust retry/noise thresholds and add upstream timeout metric (owner: Ben)
- Testing: add memory-regression unit tests and canary smoke to CI (owner: Kathy)
- Customer comms: draft status note for customers who saw 5xx (owner: Maya)
Maya (oncall): I’ll start a page to #customers-ops with a short blurb and which API keys affected.
Ben (infra): pushing gateway retry cut now. ```
# deploy gateway config change
kubectl apply -f gateway/retry-policy.yaml --context=prod
```
Tom (eng-runtime): rolling v2.7.2 to remaining pool-3 instances now. Tracking memory and restart counts.
Maya (oncall): thanks everyone. I’m downgrading paging to watch-only. Keep updates in thread.
Rina (sre): after-action items added to the incident board: https://kanban.redwood.internal/board/INC-1799004321
Kathy (qa): will add regression tests to PR for v2.7.2.
Maya (oncall): last check — 5m error rate stable at 0.6%, no visible customer impact. closing active mitigation window, moving to followup tasks.
Rina (sre): postmortem owner Rina will assemble timeline, root cause (memory regression in v2.7.1 cache init) and list remediation. Target publish in 48h.
Maya (oncall): end of thread — summary: immediate LB failover and retry policy reduction mitigated impact, engineering hotfix deployed, runbook and alert tuning assigned.
